paper.title_en: Antimagnetic rotation of neutron-deficient Cd isotopes
paper.abstract_en: The antimagnetic rotation (AMR) on the neutron-deficient Cd isotopes is investigated. The observed negative-parity yrast band with <math><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math> in <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Cd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>103</mn></mmultiscripts></math> and the positive-parity band with <math><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> in <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Cd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>104</mn></mmultiscripts></math> are fitted by using the cranked shell model plus a particle-number conserving method. For the two bands above backbending, the calculated <math><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> values display a decreasing tendency with the increasing of rotational frequency and the two-shears-like mechanism is clearly presented, thus conforming to the characteristics of AMR. On the other hand, the available experimental data indicate that Cd isotopes with <math><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo><</mo><mn>103</mn></mrow></math> do not meet the basic conditions for the existence of AMR bands. Therefore, it is judged that the Cd AMR chain may terminate at <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Cd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>103</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>104</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math>.
